Job Summary

  Location: United States

   Experience: 5+ years in Data Engineering

   Job Type: Permanent

Thinking Minds' client is looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to join their Global Card team. The role is crucial in engineering the data foundation for card, credit, payments, and product data, ensuring accuracy and timeliness. This position is vital for scaling the business and supporting analysts and data scientists with reliable data marts and schemas.

Ideal Candidate Should Have

   Experience with data pipelines

  Proficiency in data marts

   Strong understanding of data schemas

   Ability to work across the stack

   Experience with backend services

Role Overview

 The Senior Data Engineer will own the end-to-end engineering of data pipelines, schemas, and data marts. They will partner with product, analytics, and data science teams to anticipate problems and design scalable solutions. The role involves contributing to backend services and maintaining high standards of data accuracy and timeliness.

Key Responsibilities

   Develop and maintain data pipelines

   Design and implement data schemas

   Collaborate with analytics and data science teams

   Ensure data accuracy and timeliness

   Contribute to backend services

   Lead technical direction and problem anticipation

Top Skills and Modules

Responsibilities: 

Leads and develops a team of managers, technical leads, and engineers, building a strong leadership bench and high-performing engineering culture while setting performance standards, coaching, and supporting career development. Owns the end-to-end lifecycle of enterprise data products and platforms, including definition, development, delivery, and optimization, ensuring scalability, reuse, quality, and measurable business value. Directs planning, prioritization, and execution of data product roadmaps and engineering initiatives aligned to business outcomes and enterprise strategy, while driving adoption and reliability across domains. Leads the design and development of scalable data pipelines, platforms, and frameworks, enabling efficient data integration, self-service consumption, and insight generation from large, complex datasets. Establishes and enforces data quality, governance, and observability practices, ensuring data integrity, consistency, and trust across the data ecosystem. Partners with senior leaders and cross-functional teams to shape data strategy, influence operating models, and deliver high-impact, outcome-based solutions. Evaluates and implements modern data technologies and architecture patterns to improve scalability, performance, and developer experience while fostering innovation and continuous improvement. Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
Required Qualifications: 

Minimum of ten years’ business or technical experience including people management and data expertise. Undergraduate degree or equivalent combination of training and experience. Graduate degree preferred. Experience leading data engineering teams and delivering scalable data solutions. Experience partnering with business and technical stakeholders to define requirements and deliver data solutions. Experience translating business needs into data engineering solutions or products. Proven track record delivering data initiatives in complex or ambiguous environments. Experience with modern data engineering technologies, cloud platforms (e.g., AWS), and contemporary data architectures, including data lakes, real-time data processing, and platforms such as Databricks.Hands-on or leadership experience with data modeling, data quality, and data management practices.  

Preferred Qualifications: 

Graduate degree preferred. Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and analytics workflows. Experience driving change and influencing adoption across teams. Special Factors

Sponsorship

jobs_results.description:
The Data Engineer designs, builds, and maintains scalable data pipelines for Network Distribution’s enterprise data and AI platforms. This role will ingest, transform, and validate data from operational systems into reliable, business-ready datasets that support reporting, analytics, operational decision-making, and Machine Learning initiatives. The Data Engineer will collaborate with IT, BI developers, business stakeholders, and project teams, the Data Engineer develops reusable pipelines and data models while ensuring data quality, security, and performance. Success requires strong SQL and Python skills, experience with cloud data platforms, an understanding of modern data engineering and Machine Learning concepts, and a basic understanding of supply chain data such as orders, inventory, logistics, and financial reporting are essential.


  WHAT YOU'LL DO:


 
  Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines that ingest data from operational systems into the enterprise data warehouse, data lake, and AI/ML environments.
  Develop data transformation and loading processes using SQL, Python, and modern data engineering tools.
  Integrate data from ERP platforms, SaaS applications, APIs, cloud storage, and other enterprise systems.
  Develop and support ingestion processes using cloud services, APIs, file-based integrations, and data integration platforms.
  Develop and perform data validation and quality checks to ensure accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability.
  Identify data anomalies and assist with root-cause analysis and remediation.
  Support the preparation, transformation, and delivery of data used by Machine Learning and AI solutions.
  Collaborate with AI/ML engineers, developers, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements for model development and production workloads.
  Support and maintain cloud data warehouse and data lake environments.
  Support platform monitoring, automation, performance optimization, and production stability.
  Document pipeline processes, data flows, architecture, integration patterns, dependencies, and support procedures
 
 WHO YOU ARE:


 
  Demonstrates innovation, flexibility, and self-direction, managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, collaboration with cross-functional team
  Proven ability to cultivate a team-oriented environment, mentor, and engage with senior business stakeholders in business-centric dialogue.
  Skilled in documentation for requirements, design, test, and training.
  Experience in designing and implementing scalable data models and architecture.
  Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  Data Validation & Quality Assurance
  Analytical Thinking & Troubleshooting
  Technical Documentation
  Strong SQL development, query optimization, data transformation, and ETL/ELT pipeline development experience.
  Experience with Snowflake, including data warehousing, data modeling, performance optimization, and cloud-based data processing.
  Experience with cloud platforms and services such as AWS.
  Python development and scripting experience.
  Experience with APIs, data ingestion, integration technologies, and structured and semi-structured data, including JSON and XML.
  Understanding of data warehouse architecture, data modeling, data validation, monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
  Working knowledge of Machine Learning concepts and experience preparing and transforming data to support ML models and AI/ML workloads.
  Familiarity with AWS services such as S3, Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, and SageMaker or similar cloud technologies.
  Experience with SAP or other enterprise ERP data is preferred.
  Familiarity with dbt, Terraform, CI/CD, Git, Java, or similar development and deployment technologies.
  Exposure to Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and enterprise AI platforms is preferred
 
 WHAT YOU'LL HAVE:


 
  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  Minimum of five (5) years of experience in data engineering, data integration, data warehousing, analytics engineering, or software development involving significant data responsibilities
  Strong understanding of data architecture, enterprise systems, and business process automation.
  Strong understanding of data governance frameworks.
  Knowledge of information security principles and data protection best practices.
  Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives while managing operational responsibilities.
  Understanding of data processing concepts (ETL/ELT).
  Understanding of data warehouse architecture and data modeling concepts.
 
 

 


  WHAT WE OFFER:


 
  Competitive compensation
  Medical, dental, & vision coverage
  Generous PTO policy
  Summer/Flex Hours all year round
  Learning & Development Opportunities
  Progressive Wellness Program
  401k matching program
  Generous Profit Sharing contribution
  FUN work environment with many company sponsored events
 
 OUR CULTURE & WHAT MAKES US DIFFERENT


 
  Our Values are the strategic principles that guide the company and our associates. Commitment to Excellence, Adaptability, Collaborative Relationships and Integrity serve as our cultural cornerstones and are integrated into every action taken or decision made across the organization.
 
 INNOVATION IS IN OUR DNA


 
  We don't just welcome new ideas - we thrive on them. Our team stays ahead of the curve with the latest data, technologies and best practices.
 
 GROWTH MINDSET


 
  We believe in continuous learning. Whether it's attending tech conferences, taking courses, or exploring new tools, we invest in your
 
 WORK-LIFE HARMONY

The job details are as follows:



Who We Are



We are the first publicly-traded biotech or pharmaceutical company to take the form of a public benefit corporation. Our public benefit purpose is to provide a brighter future for patients through the development of novel pharmaceutical therapies; and technologies that expand the availability of transplantable organs.



United Therapeutics (Nasdaq: UTHR) seeks to travel down the corridors of indifference to develop treatments for rare, deadly diseases. We were founded in 1996 by a family seeking a cure for their daughter’s pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH). Today, we have six FDA-approved therapies that treat PAH, pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease (PH-ILD) and neuroblastoma, a rare pediatric cancer. Our near-term pipeline seeks to develop additional therapies for PAH and pulmonary fibrosis (PF).



The cure for end-stage life-threatening diseases like PAH, PH-ILD, PF, and many others is an organ transplant, but only a small percentage of donated organs are available to address the vast need. For this reason, we are working to create manufactured organs to address the shortage of kidneys, hearts, lungs, and livers available for transplant. We believe an unlimited supply of tolerable, transplantable organs will eliminate the transplant waiting list and cure end-stage organ diseases for which transplant is not currently an option.



Who You Are



You're a problem solver who thrives at the intersection of technology and business. You enjoy building relationships, navigating complex challenges, and leading solutions that drive meaningful outcomes. You can confidently manage multiple high-impact initiatives, work across diverse stakeholder groups, and translate business needs into technical solutions. Most importantly, you're energized by helping teams make better decisions through data and analytics. Company Overview


Maas Energy Works is the leading developer and operator of agricultural waste-to-energy systems in the United States. The Company designs, develops, constructs, and operates biogas renewable energy generation systems, primarily on dairy farms. Our projects include anaerobic digesters, biogas-powered electric generation, and renewable natural gas upgrading.



Position Description
We are hiring a Data Engineer to own the operational backbone of our data platform: SQL Servers, the pipelines that move data out of it, and the Microsoft Fabric data warehouse that feeds reporting, regulatory work, and internal applications. The data is high-frequency time-series and operational data from more than 100 projects, so reliability, completeness, and monitoring matter as much as building new things.
This is a hands-on role on a small team that is actively modernizing its platform. We want someone who learns new tools on their own initiative, takes ownership of production systems, and wants to grow with the platform.


Essential Responsibilities
 


•    Administer the SQL Server environment in Azure: backups and restore testing, SQL Agent jobs, index and statistics maintenance, security and access, storage growth, and performance tuning.
•    Monitor continuous data ingestion from 100+ projects and resolve gaps, delays, duplicates, and out-of-range values before they reach downstream reporting.
•    Build, maintain, and troubleshoot pipelines that move data from staging and external REST APIs into the Fabric data warehouse.
•    Maintain and extend the warehouse's dimensional models, data quality rules, and load performance.
•    Build alerting for pipeline failures, data freshness, and completeness, and own the response when they fire.
•    Contribute to the migration of remaining workloads from Azure Synapse to Microsoft Fabric.
•    Support analysts and application developers who consume warehouse data through Power BI semantic models and internal applications.
•    Write and maintain runbooks and technical documentation, and work in Git with code review and CI/CD deployment.


Required Qualifications
•    3+ years of professional experience with SQL Server and T-SQL, including set-based query design, stored procedures, execution-plan tuning, and indexing.
•    Hands-on database administration in production: backup and recovery, SQL Agent, maintenance jobs, logins and role-based security, and capacity monitoring.
•    Experience building and operating production ETL/ELT pipelines (Azure Data Factory, Synapse pipelines, Fabric Data Factory, or SSIS), including incremental loads, failure handling, and reruns.
•    Working knowledge of dimensional modeling: facts, dimensions, grain, and slowly changing dimensions.
•    Hands-on Microsoft Fabric experience: Warehouse and Lakehouse, Data Factory pipelines, Dataflow Gen2, notebooks, and capacity monitoring.
•    Familiarity with Azure fundamentals: resource organization, networking basics, managed identities, and Key Vault.
•    Experience implementing data quality checks, monitoring, or alerting production data.
•    Proficiency with Git.
•    A track record of learning new tools and platforms independently and applying them to real work.
•    Python, and C# programming languages
•    Spark framework


Preferred Qualifications
•    Experience with Power BI semantic models
•    Experience with high-volume time-series, IoT, or industrial operations data.
•    Microsoft certification DP-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer) or DP-700 (Fabric Data Engineer).
 


Other Duties

Standard Job Description

Join Lockheed Martin's Data & AI Enablement organization and accelerate the company's AI transformation. As a lead data engineer, you will design, build, and productize data assets that power AI agents, analytics, and enterprise applications across the Enterprise Data Ecosystem (EDE). In addition, you will lead the development, governance, and expansion of the enterprise ontology, ensuring consistent semantic definitions and relationships across all data products.

Key Responsibilities

Lead end‑to‑end development of corporate and functional data models and pipelines - from raw data ingestion from source systems to gold-layer entities - so that they can be productized as certified data products.Define product vision, roadmap, SLAs, usage metrics, and continuous‑improvement cycles for all data assets.Develop, maintain, and govern the Enterprise ontology (concepts, relationships, taxonomies) and deploy it for use by AI agents and analytics applications across the corporation.Ensure data models deliver clean, well‑documented feature sets for machine‑learning pipelines; work with data scientists to embed model‑ready attributes (feature stores, lineage metadata).Implement security, governance, and compliance (encryption, fine‑grained access, data lineage) via Unity Catalog and cloud IAMCollaborate with team architects to validate designs.Optimize Databricks performance with auto‑scaling, caching, and Delta Lake tuning.Establish standards, best practices, and certification processes for data products and ontology assets.Mentor and develop engineering talent through code reviews, hands‑on workshops, paired‑programming, and defined growth paths/competency matrices.Advise on the technology stack used in team operations.Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's (or higher) in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Information Management, or a related field.7 + years of large-scale data architecture/engineering experience, with at least 4 years focused on productizing data assets for enterprise consumption.Significant experience developing ontologies.Demonstrated ability to probe for and understand core customer needs as opposed to surface-level needs.Strong programming skills in Python and SQL; proficient with Spark (PySpark/Scala) and deep experience with AI-assisted development..Experience with data‑integration/orchestration tools (e.g., NiFi, Airflow) for pipeline development.Must be a US citizen.Desired Skills

Experience with Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Jobs/Workflows).Experience with federated data models and ontologies.Excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills for cross‑functional teamwork and internal‑customer support.Master's degree or advanced technical training (optional).Databricks certifications (Data Engineer Associate/Professional) or comparable big‑data credentials.Experience developing applications leveraging genAI.Pay Information
